verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe inviting teammates into a shared project where each person can start new Agent threads while working together (replit-docs-14), and there's a git-lock conflict incident showing rough edges in concurrent multi-actor editing (replit-comm-5). No evidence of richer team features like roles/permissions, real-time cursors, or comments. missing for 10: evidence of granular collaboration features (permissions, live co-editing indicators, comments/review flow), and independent corroboration of smooth multi-user teamwork beyond the single conflict report.
